title: ==SENIOR QUANTITATIVE MODEL SOLUTIONS SPECIALIST==  ·  TEST AUTOMATION

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Senior Quantitative Model Solutions Specialist== with **9+ years** of experience across UI and API test automation — from tool selection and framework design to script development, suite execution, and defect reporting. ==automated backend APIs with REST Assured and Postman, and built Python-based API test suites==. ==designed Selenium + Java + TestNG automation frameworks across e-commerce, automotive, and enterprise web platforms==, differentiated by owning the full automation lifecycle — from framework design through CI/CD integration to defect reporting — independently.

roles.title: Quality Assurance Manager
roles.meta: Mar 2019 – Jan 2022  |  Berlin, Germany  |  Automotive / in-car infotainment
bullets: Designed a test automation framework using Selenium, Java, and TestNG for the in-car infotainment app.
Owned testing of the Volkswagen in-car infotainment app "We Experience" for the VW Passat and VW Golf as the sole QA resource on the product.
Analyzed real-time app performance while driving the vehicle and debugged logs from the car's backend systems.
Automated infotainment system backend APIs using the REST Assured framework and Postman for manual API testing.
Used Maven as the build management tool and Jenkins / Travis CI for continuous integration.
Wrote test cases for the infotainment car application in the XRay test case management tool and produced daily and weekly status reports.
Followed Scrum and Kanban Agile methodology, managing test case preparation, execution, defect tracking, and reporting for the team.

Tested application compatibility across browser versions (IE, Firefox, Chrome) and across mobile, desktop, and tablet environments.
Tested backend Magento e-commerce modules and deployed features to test servers for manual and automated testing.
Used Git for version control and worked within AWS infrastructure.
Performed the complete testing lifecycle — regression testing of fixed bugs and new builds, sanity testing, and user testing — following Scrum and Kanban.
